assessment: The role of Replication Factor C (RFC) in DNA replication and repair has been known for many years. RFC/PCNA binds to a double strand-single strand DNA junction with a 3'-recessed end, with the DNA passing through a central chamber in the five-subunit protein. The current paper reports structures of RFC/PCNA with two separate DNA molecules, one containing the well characterized 3'-recessed DNA and surprisingly, a second 5'-recessed DNA outside the central chamber. The paper is an important addition to understanding RFC function, particularly in DNA repair.
